entries.summary: An Agent-home projection may carry an optional hostRevision, a non-negative safe integer owned by the Host. The daemon orders projections by (profileRevision, hostRevision), an absent hostRevision being 0: a greater key applies whatever the projectionHash, a lower key is stale, and an equal key is idempotent or conflict by hash. A Host that changes its rendering of the home without a new profileRevision raises hostRevision, and the existing home is projected again without clearing data. A Host that never sends hostRevision keeps the profileRevision order. The daemon advertises the new device flag agent-home-projection-host-revision, and the Cloud refuses a projection carrying hostRevision for a device that did not advertise it. The ordering record .byok/agent-home-projection.json keeps version 1 and stores hostRevision only when the applied payload carried it. An older client reads only the fields it knows, so after a rollback it ignores the stored hostRevision and orders by profileRevision alone.
